1. Undo the bolts fixing the movement handles.

2. Open the left and right backrest folding handles (2a) and disconnect the control cables (2b).

3. Open the sliding handle (3a) and disconnect the two control cables (3b).

4. Remove the seat movement handles.

Connect the right backrest folding control cable to the seat movement handles.

Connect the left backrest folding control cable to the seat movement handles.

Connect the seat sliding control cable to the seat movement handles.

Position in the seat movement handles in the housing in the cushion frame and tighten the fixing bolts.

Check the operation of the movement control handles, making sure that the two backrests fold over correctly and the guides slide properly.
